practice.lead: From drafting in Dhaka to permit sets in New York.
paragraphs: I trained as an architect at North South University in Dhaka and spent six years in practice there, moving from producing construction documents to leading projects and running site supervision.
I moved to the United States to study project management at Northeastern University, learning the scheduling, budgeting and resource-planning side of the same work.
I work in AutoCAD, Revit, SketchUp and Rhino, render in Lumion, and schedule in Microsoft Project.
